title: Synthesis of fluorinated 3-aminobenzofurans via a tandem SNAr-cyclocondensation strategy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12843-12853
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02024G, Paper

Hugh W. Tawell, William Robinson, Yuqi Li, Graham J. Tizzard, Simon J. Coles, Avninder S. Bhambra, Mark Edgar, George W. Weaver
Twenty-seven fluorinated benzofurans have been synthesised by tandem SNAr-cyclocondensation in a programme to develop rapid access to new heterocyclic scaffolds.
